##: Scoop manifest for knaif, rendered by installers/windows/scoop/render-manifest.sh from the
published Windows .zip and committed to the bucket as bucket/knaif.json
(blackdeep-tech/scoop-knaif). Do not edit a rendered copy: change this template and render again.
It unpacks the published tree untouched and puts its bin/ on the user's PATH, as setup.exe
does; knaif.exe finds skills/ and contracts/ next to itself. No shim: Scoop's shim.exe is
unsigned and Smart App Control blocks it, while the signed knaif.exe runs. ffmpeg is a
dependency because the ffmpeg skill cannot run without it; the documents skill's tools are
optional and suggested; the model is never downloaded at install time.
